by: charities-a session (Fable), step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at the merge of the build kept)
title: One page of the Charities Register's open data feed (OData v2, JSON): up to 1,000 rows of one entity set, ordered by its key, as the capture lane asked for it

landmarks: a JSON object whose d is a list of rows, or an object with results (a list) and __count
every row carries __metadata.type = Charities_ODATAModel.<entity set> and the set's key field (OrganisationId, OfficerId, AnnualReturnId, GroupId, or the code list's id)

signals_note: GET http://www.odata.charities.govt.nz/<set>?$format=json&$orderby=<key>&$top=1000[&$filter=<key> gt <last>][&$inlinecount=allpages], through the fetch gate, 5 s apart, off-peak; the bytes landed verbatim by hash by registers/charities/capture.py.
notes: Dates arrive as 2013-06-17T00:00:00Z: the day is taken, the register's own. Officers carry no address or birth date (the register does not publish them) and no contact detail is read from any set. The vOrganisations page carries the lists the register shows beside an organisation (activities, sectors, beneficiaries, areas, sources of funds) and is merged into the organisation's row, cited as lists_document.
applies_to: the Charities Register's feed, from 20 October 2026
process: Key a charity on its charity number, an officer on OfficerId, a return on AnnualReturnId, a group on GroupId: the register's own identifiers, stable across passes.
Resolve MainActivityId, MainSectorId, MainBeneficiaryId and ReportingTierId through the code lists landed with the pages; an id the lists do not name is kept and counted unresolved.

Set aside a row with no key, an organisation with no charity number or name, an officer or return of an organisation the copy does not hold, a name field that reads as an address, a return with no period end.
gates: Every row of every page is a typed row or a catch-log line (files: rows = typed + set aside + filtered).
A page whose rows say they are of another set than it is listed under raises.
